mainEntity.name: How do I book a minicab from Canning Town E16 to Heathrow Airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: Book online through our secure platform, call our team directly, or complete a reservation in minutes. All Canning Town E16 bookings receive instant confirmation with driver details and a guaranteed fixed price.

mainEntity.name: How far is Canning Town E16 from Heathrow Airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: Canning Town E16 is approximately 16 miles (26 km) from Heathrow Airport via the A13 westbound connecting to the A406 North Circular and then the A40 towards Heathrow. Journey times typically range from 40 to 60 minutes depending on traffic conditions along the A13 corridor and the A40 westbound approach.

mainEntity.name: What is the minicab fare from Canning Town E16 to Heathrow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our Canning Town E16 to Heathrow saloon fare starts from £65 with a fully fixed price. The airport pickup fare is slightly higher at £70 to include terminal waiting and parking allowances.

mainEntity.name: Is Meet and Greet available at Heathrow for Canning Town E16 passengers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our complimentary Meet & Greet service is available at all four Heathrow terminals. Your chauffeur waits in the arrivals hall with a personalised name board and assists with luggage before your transfer to Canning Town E16.

mainEntity.name: Is LTR Minicab available 24 hours a day from Canning Town E16?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our Canning Town E16 minicab service operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week including public holidays, with no out-of-hours surcharges applied to any booking.

mainEntity.name: Is LTR Minicab an affordable Heathrow transfer from Canning Town E16?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. LTR Minicab provides competitive fixed-price Heathrow transfers from Canning Town E16 from £65 for a Saloon. All fares are locked in at booking with no surge pricing, meter additions, or hidden charges.

mainEntity.name: Which airports can I travel to from Canning Town E16?

acceptedAnswer.text: We operate direct transfers from Canning Town E16 to Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton, London City, and Southend Airport with fixed fares and professional licensed chauffeurs.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer group transfers from Canning Town E16?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We provide MPV 5, MPV 6, MPV 7, and MPV 8 vehicles for families and groups travelling from Canning Town E16 to airports, hotels, and UK destinations.

mainEntity.name: Do you cover Rathbone Market, ExCeL London, and all streets within E16?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We cover all streets and postcodes within E16 including Barking Road, Rathbone Market, Victoria Dock Road, the ExCeL London area, Silvertown, North Woolwich Road, and all surrounding residential and commercial areas throughout the Canning Town and Royal Docks borough.

mainEntity.name: Is the Canning Town E16 minicab service available on weekends and bank holidays?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our Canning Town E16 minicab service runs every day of the year including weekends and all UK bank holidays at no additional cost.
